payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the image visibly appear as a completed pencil drawing?
node.criteria: Compose both supports under R1 without treating either support as completion credit by itself. Complete (yes) only when s1 passes. Partial only when s1 does not pass, s2 passes, and the evidence is sufficient to establish some requested progress without complete fulfillment. Absent (no) only when s1 fails and s2 fails, with sufficient evidence that no requested change has progressed. Unknown when required evidence is unresolved, including when s1 is unknown and completion cannot be established, or when s2 is unknown and absence or partial progress cannot be established. Unrelated edits never count as progress.
